title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Revealed at State of Play
description: Sony's latest State of Play showcases revealed a wealth of PS5 news, highlighted by the official announcement of the GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 controllers.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Highlight Sony's Massive State of Play Showcase

In a recent double-feature State of Play livestream event—combining a general showcase with a dedicated State of Play Japan broadcast—Sony dropped a massive wave of announcements, release dates, and trailers for the PS5. While the streams were packed with updates on major upcoming titles, the biggest highlight for fans of Rockstar Games was the official reveal of the **GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers**.

### GTA 6 Limited Edition Controllers Arrive November 19

According to the official announcement, the highly anticipated GTA 6 limited edition PS5 controllers are scheduled to launch on **19th November 2026**. As one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in history, any official hardware tie-in for Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece is bound to capture immense collector attention.

### Major Highlights from the PS5 Showcase

Aside from the exciting GTA 6 hardware news, the back-to-back showcases delivered a plethora of gaming updates:

* **Final Fantasy 7 Revelation**: The trilogy finale is officially set for **April**, featuring loads of new PS5 gameplay.
* **Until Dawn 2**: Launching sooner than expected with a confirmed date of **January 2027**.
* **Ghost of Yotei**: Jin Sakai returns as a playable character in the game's Most Wanted Mode, alongside a proper look at the *Echoes of Sekigahara* DLC.
* **Monster Hunter Wilds**: A massive new expansion was showcased, looking visually mind-blowing.
* **Metro 2039**: Locked down a **4th February 2027** release date alongside its first PS5 clips.
* **Maneater 2**: The fan-favourite shark-RPG makes its return on PS5 in **2027**.

### Editor's Take

While this State of Play didn't grant us a brand-new gameplay trailer for GTA 6 itself, the confirmation of official themed hardware proves the marketing machine is steadily gearing up. The November 19 release for the limited-edition controllers gives fans a concrete collectible to secure as we inch closer to returning to the ultimate open-world sandbox.
